- The competition is evaluated using the global Dice coefficient.
- The Dice coefficient formula is \(2 \times \frac{|X \cap Y|}{|X| + |Y|}\), where \(X\) is the set of predicted contrail pixels and \(Y\) is the ground truth set of contrail pixels.

Submission Format:
- Use run-length encoding on the pixel values to reduce the submission file size.
- Submit pairs of values indicating the start position and run length of the masked pixels.
- The file should have a header and follow this format:
  - `record_id,encoded_pixels`
  - Example
